name: notice-board-visit-unclaimed-v1
description: ⭐ DEAN'S VARIANT OF THE NOTICE BOARD VISIT, RULED 11/09/2026, AND THIS IS THE ARM THAT CARRIES IT. It is still built as an ARM and not as the default: measure it against the Notice Board visit as built and against the shipped commons on identical reference-v15 seeds, put the numbers in front of Dean, and only then flip anything. The design it varies is docs/notice-board-visit-handoff-2026-09-10-v2.md, rules S1-S16. THE RULE IN ONE LINE: self-visiting is BANNED, and the Notice Board of every suit NO PLAYER IS FARMING goes to the centre of the table, ownerless, with a face-up public pile that anybody may play onto and that anybody may harvest at three cards or more. Everything else is the arm: the bonus is still to play ONE card from your hand onto a Notice Board, taken FIRST, and a card played onto a PLAYER'S board still rests there until that player harvests it into their barn, which is their whole payment and there is no other. ⭐ WHY IT EXISTS, AND IT IS MEASURED RATHER THAN ARGUED. The Notice Board visit was built and measured on 10/09/2026 at 4,820 games per arm. THE BONUS SLOT WAS USED ON 71.2% OF TURNS against Dean's band of 30% to 60%, out of band at EVERY SEAT COUNT, and 44.4% OF ALL VISITS WENT TO THE VISITOR'S OWN BOARD - 58.4% at two players - against v31's 22.2% when every board printed the SAME thing, which is the number S6's variety argument was supposed to beat. overlays/notice-board-visit-no-self-v1.overlay.json fixes exactly that (46.4% pooled, and cross-table traffic nearly doubles) AND THEN STARVES AT TWO PLAYERS: 29.1% of turns, below Dean's own 30% floor, because with self-visiting banned and only two suits in play THERE IS EXACTLY ONE BOARD A SEAT MAY VISIT. This variant fixes the starve by arithmetic rather than by price. Five Notice Boards exist in every game, you may never visit your own, and the ones nobody is farming stand in the middle, so EVERY SEAT FACES EXACTLY FOUR TARGETS AT EVERY PLAYER COUNT, solo included: at 1 player 1 own / 0 rivals' / 4 central; at 2 players 1 / 1 / 3; at 3 players 1 / 2 / 2; at 4 players 1 / 3 / 1. ⭐ AND IT RESTORES A STANDING DEAN RULING THE BUILT DESIGN SILENTLY BROKE: ALL FIVE ACTIONS MUST EXIST IN EVERY GAME, which fails today because at two players only two Notice Boards are in play at all, so three of the five powers are simply absent from the table. ⛔ THE HEADLINE RISK, AND IT IS THE NUMBER THAT DECIDES THE VARIANT. A CENTRAL BOARD IS SOCIALLY FREE AND A RIVAL'S BOARD IS NOT. The card you pay to a rival's board is material that rival harvests into their barn, which is the whole of this design's thesis - PAY THE GIVER IN THE SAME ACT, the fault the Lopiano lens named in all seven previous bonus slots - and the card you pay to a central board is paid to nobody. So there is a STANDING INCENTIVE TO PREFER THE CENTRE at every seat count, and it is strongest at two players, where three of the four targets are central and the one rival board is the only place a gift can land. IF CROSS-TABLE VISITS FALL RATHER THAN RISE, THE VARIANT HAS RECREATED THE VILLAGE GREEN WITH AN EXTRA STEP and the neighbour has been designed out for the second time in three days. Read the OWN / RIVAL / CENTRAL split of every play, and visits RECEIVED per player, BY SEAT COUNT, before reading the bonus rate at all: the rate can land inside the band while the design has quietly stopped being about neighbours. ⚠️ THE CENTRE IS THE EXISTING COMMONS AND NOT A THIRD SHAPE, WHICH IS WHY THIS ARM ADDS ONE KNOB RATHER THAN FOUR. A play onto a rival's board stays the visit move; a play onto a central board is the commons move that has been in the engine since 09/09/2026. THE 3+ RULE ON A CENTRAL PILE IS THEREFORE SPELLED WITH KNOBS THAT ALREADY EXIST, and each of the four does a different job: rules.economy.commonsThreshold null is the NEVER BLOCKED half (it caps the INFLOW, and null means no cap, so any number of cards may be added and nothing in the game refuses a play); rules.economy.commonsHarvestMin 3 is the HARVESTABLE AT 3 half (it gates the OUTFLOW, so a pile below three cards may not be taken by anybody and a pile at three or more may be taken by ANYBODY); rules.economy.commonsHarvestTake null keeps a harvest taking the WHOLE pile rather than a capped slice of it; and rules.turn.commonsTake 'harvest' is the value that lets Harvest reach the centre at all, because every other value of that knob routes the centre's outflow somewhere else and would read a farm bypass of 0% by construction. ⭐ A HARVEST IS A HARVEST (D1, reaffirmed by Dean on 11/09/2026): one of your full buildings OR any central board at or above the threshold, MAIN ACTION OR BOUGHT THROUGH THE WHEAT NOTICE BOARD POWER, with no rules exception either way. That was Dean's explicit reason and it is the reason the Wheat power needs no special case here. ⭐ THE 2x2, AND IT EXISTS BECAUSE THIS VARIANT CHANGES TWO THINGS AT ONCE. Ruling in a bundle rules in the bundle (05/09/2026), so the pass must be able to separate the ban on self-visiting from the unclaimed boards. Self-visiting ON with no centre is overlays/notice-board-visit-v1.overlay.json; self-visiting OFF with no centre is overlays/notice-board-visit-no-self-v1.overlay.json; self-visiting ON with the centre is overlays/notice-board-visit-unclaimed-self-v1.overlay.json; and self-visiting OFF with the centre is overlays/notice-board-visit-unclaimed-v1.overlay.json, WHICH IS DEAN'S VARIANT. Each corner differs from its neighbours in ONE thing, which is what makes any pair attributable; packages/data/src/data.test.ts diffs the loaded set blocks so the 2x2 cannot silently stop being a 2x2. ⛔ EVERY PASSENGER IS PINNED BY NAME AND HERE IS THE LIST, because the 05/09/2026 lesson is that ruling an arm in rules in its whole bundle and the meeple supply cap shipped at 2 that way without anybody arguing for it. EIGHTEEN LEAVES, in five groups. THE DESIGN ITSELF, four: (1) rules.turn.visitCurrency 'noticeBoardPower' - the fourth value, and NOT a repointing of 'card', because 'card' is the v31 control and carries three passengers this design does not want (a BLOCKING board threshold of 2, the standalone free Draw 1 in the bonus slot, and the turn-start meeple spend) and one of the three named controls may never move under an arm it is read against; (2) rules.turn.bonusTiming 'start' - the shipped order, S5, bonus FIRST because a turn visibly ends on the main action, pinned so the arm cannot silently stop being itself if the default ever flips again; (3) rules.economy.noticeBoardThreshold 3 - S8, and it is a MINIMUM; (4) rules.economy.noticeBoardBlocks false - S8's plus sign, so cards may always be added to an owned board, nothing ever blocks, and no owner can shut a board by declining to harvest. THE TWO KNOBS THIS 2x2 SEPARATES, two: (5) rules.turn.selfVisitAllowed false - the ban this variant is half made of, and the reason the other half exists: the no-self control on its own starves at two players, and the centre is what feeds it back; (6) rules.economy.unclaimedBoardsToCentre true - the new knob of 11/09/2026, which sends the Notice Board of every suit nobody is farming to the centre of the table, ownerless, with a public pile. THE 3+ RULE ON A CENTRAL PILE, four, and every one of them a knob that already existed: (7) rules.turn.commonsTake 'harvest', (8) rules.economy.commonsThreshold null, (9) rules.economy.commonsHarvestMin 3 and (10) rules.economy.commonsHarvestTake null. ⚠️ THREE OF THOSE FOUR WERE DELIBERATELY LEFT UNPINNED BY overlays/notice-board-visit-v1.overlay.json, ON THE GROUND THAT THEY RATION A CENTRAL PILE AND THAT ARM HAS NO CENTRE. THIS ARM HAS ONE, so what was subjectless there is load-bearing here, and an unpinned commonsHarvestMin would have handed the centre the shipped commons rule instead - any pile of one card, harvestable by anybody - which is a different game from the one Dean ruled. THE COMMONS FEE RULES AND THE COINS, TURNED OFF BY NAME, four: (11) rules.economy.commonsColourMatch false - any card pays for any board, on a central board as on an owned one; (12) rules.economy.commonsWildPair false, which means nothing without the gate above it and is pinned beside it so the pair can never arrive on its own; (13) rules.economy.endgameCoinCost null - the fifteen Endgame cards go back to two cards of their own suit (S14); (14) rules.economy.farmsteadCoinPower false - the whole coin economy of 10/09/2026 is superseded and the Farmstead is a token tray with six printed slots and no rules text (S4). THE MEEPLES, STILL NOWHERE, four: (15) rules.turn.startingMeeplesPerColour 0, (16) rules.turn.meepleAsCard false, (17) rules.turn.slotToll null and (18) rules.turn.meepleCapPerColour null. All four are already the shipped values and are pinned anyway, because no meeples is part of THIS design rather than something it inherits, and a pin is what stops an inheritance turning into a passenger. ⭐ AND THREE PASSENGERS NOBODY HAD NAMED, FOUND BY READING THE CODE RATHER THAN THE DESIGN, WHICH IS WHY THEY ARE WRITTEN OUT HERE. ⛔ (1) THE APIARY BOARD'S ACTION, AND IT IS THE ONE A BUILDER MUST RULE ON BEFORE THE FIRST RUN. doorActionForSuit in packages/data substitutes workers.roster.sow.actionUnderCommons - the Apiary board's GROW, C3 of the commons - ONLY while isCommons is true, and under this arm the currency is 'noticeBoardPower', so isCommons is FALSE while there are central boards on the table. A central Apiary board asked for its door action therefore answers SOW and not GROW, which is the commons rule silently changing underneath a centre that is otherwise the commons. THERE IS NO LEAF TO PIN: the roster already carries both values and the gate is code, so this is a decision for the engine and it has to be made rather than inherited. The same seam decides the larger question this data pass is deliberately neutral on - whether a CENTRAL board grants the plain commons action or the amplified S12 POWER its owned twin grants - which changes what the centre is worth and therefore changes the headline risk above. ⚠️ (2) meepleIndexForSpace answers -1 under 'commons' and falls through to the v31 IDENTITY for anything else, so under 'noticeBoardPower' it answers index 0 for a tile that holds nothing. Its sibling meeplesPerTile was taught about the fourth currency on 10/09/2026 and this one was not. It is harmless only because meeplesPerTile answers 0, so no meeple is ever dealt for it to index; it is a latent seam rather than a live bug, and it is recorded rather than fixed because fixing it under an arm mid-build is how a passenger gets made. ⚠️ (3) rules.turn.meepleAsCardGoesTo, rules.turn.paymentSlotToll and rules.turn.paymentHostChoice are PINNED ONLY BY PROXY: every one of them is read behind rules.turn.meepleAsCard, which this overlay pins false, so none of them has a subject. They are named rather than pinned because adding three leaves that say nothing would break the 2x2 diff this arm exists to support. ⚠️ WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT PINNED, AND WHY, because an unexplained absence reads as an oversight. rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.* - the five S12 power numbers as amended by rulings C88 and C89 - are the BASE values and every arm in this family reads them unchanged; pinning them here would make a repricing invisible to this arm and visible to its pair. workers.roster.* is the DOOR roster and an owned board grants a POWER rather than a door, so its numbers describe nothing on an owned board; see the Apiary note above for what they DO decide on a central one. rules.turn.bonusDraw stays 1 and is NOT a switch: the standalone free Draw 1 is a v31 slot SHAPE rather than a number, so no overlay can turn it off and the engine must not reach the 'card' slot branch under this currency. And the engine's hand limit of 7 is the SIMULATOR'S BOUND and not a rule of the game (C7): the table plays with none, and every report header must say so. ⭐ WHAT TO READ, IN ORDER, AND THE FIRST TWO ARE NOT THE RATE. (1) THE OWN / RIVAL / CENTRAL SPLIT OF EVERY PLAY, BY SEAT COUNT, and own must read ZERO by construction: a non-zero own share is a bug in the ban rather than a finding. (2) VISITS RECEIVED PER PLAYER against overlays/notice-board-visit-no-self-v1.overlay.json on identical seeds, WHICH IS THE WHOLE VARIANT: if cross-table traffic FALLS when the centre opens, the centre has eaten the neighbour and the answer is not more centre. (3) The bonus rate on the TURN measure, by seat count, against Dean's 30% to 60%. The number this variant was ruled to rescue is the 29.1% the no-self control read at TWO PLAYERS, so read two players first and the pooled figure second. ⚠️ Judging that band on PLAYS PER TURN rather than turns cost this project a re-run on 09/09/2026, and A Helping Hand is worth about ten points of the difference. (4) The spread between the busiest and quietest board, split OWNED against CENTRAL: a central board has no owner to pay, so a central board leading the table is the risk above arriving as a number. (5) THE STALL (a20) on owned boards, and the central piles' median size at harvest beside it. The commons read a median of 2.0 at harvest, and commonsHarvestMin 3 is a floor ABOVE that median, which is the cap-of-two lesson of 05/09/2026 pointing the other way and the thing most likely to leave a central pile sitting unharvested. (6) The farm bypass, which now has TWO sources and must be SPLIT: cards that reached a barn as somebody else's fee, and cards that reached a barn out of the centre. (7) Barn glut, action inflation, game length, deliveries per player, own-crop build share. (8) Two players specifically, at every one of the above. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, and always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors, reference-v15 seeds). A bare --watchlist is a 1,580-game pilot and must not be quoted beside a real run. Stay on reference-v15 and cut reference-v16 only when Dean rules the variant in. The controls are the shipped commons baseline (reports/watchlist-2026-09-09T16-41-51-reference-v15.txt), the Notice Board visit as built (overlays/notice-board-visit-v1.overlay.json, 71.2% of turns and 44.4% self-visits), its no-self control (overlays/notice-board-visit-no-self-v1.overlay.json, 46.4% self-visits and 29.1% of turns at two players) and overlays/v31-card-visit.overlay.json, whose 22.2% is the only prior self-visit number there is. UNBUILT AND UNRUN BEFORE THIS PASS.
